value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor looks hot: high around 29 with a humidex near 35. Early morning could bring a shower or a thunderstorm (about 30% chance), then it clears by morning. Winds pick up late morning, southwest at about 40 km/h gusting to 60. Tuesday night turns cloudy with a 40% chance of showers and a low of 15.
